settings.title: Media studio
settings.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg not found. Install it, or set its path below.
settings.checkHint: SSH host. Check connects and looks for ffmpeg there.
settings.agentToolHint: Agents can show media in the chat as they make it. Applies to new and reopened sessions.
settings.turnCardsHint: After the agent's reply, one card with the media the turn showed and the media files it created or changed in the agent's folder. Paseo folds finished turns, and this card stays in view.
settings.qualityHint: Auto sends H.264 video as it is and converts the rest to a 720p proxy.
settings.hardwareHint: Convert with VideoToolbox on a Mac or NVENC on an NVIDIA GPU when one works.
settings.uploadFolderHint: Inside the workspace, for uploads from Recent and the Command Center.
settings.framesFolderHint: Inside the workspace. Frames attached to notes are saved here as PNG.
settings.remoteHostsHint: Hosts whose files can be shown as alias:/path. * means every alias in ~/.ssh/config ({{aliases}}). Empty turns this off.
settings.ffmpegPathHint: Leave empty to search PATH, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.
settings.remoteFfmpegHint: Only for hosts where ffmpeg is not found by itself: alias=/path/to/ffmpeg, comma-separated. PATH, common folders and the ffmpeg bundled with the imageio-ffmpeg Python package are searched first.

pending.title: Unfinished uploads
pending.hint: Press Resume and pick the same file, or drop it here again, to continue where it stopped.
pending.discard: Discard the upload and the part already sent
pending.wrongFile: That is not {{name}} ({{size}}). Pick the same file to resume.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Click the player or the list first; keys are ignored while you type.
shortcuts.goto: Go to a timecode (or just type the numbers)

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: Notes you send to agents show up here and on the timeline.

details.loudHint: Louder than the −14 LUFS most streaming and social platforms normalize to; they will turn it down.
details.quietHint: Quieter than −14 LUFS; it will sound quieter than other videos on most platforms.
details.peakHint: True peak above −1 dBTP: likely to clip once the platform re-encodes it.
